title: Mathematics Grade 10 Practice Questions 2017
description: Mathematics Grade 10 Practice Questions 2017 - 3 multiple choice questions. Ethiopian national exam preparation material.

questions.questionText: 28) A spherical fuel container with radius $3 \text{ m}$ is filled with fuel. What is the amount (in $\text{m}^3$) of fuel in the container?
questions.explanation: The amount of fuel in the container is equal to the **Volume ($V$) of the sphere**. The formula for the volume of a sphere with radius $r$ is $V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$. The radius is given as $r = 3 \text{ m}$. \n$V = \frac{4}{3}\pi (3 \text{ m})^3 = \frac{4}{3}\pi (27 \text{ m}^3)$. \n$V = 4\pi \cdot \frac{27}{3} = 4\pi \cdot 9 = 36\pi \text{ m}^3$.

questions.questionText: What is the surface area (in $	ext{cm}^2$) of leather material required for a spherical shape ball of radius $25 	ext{ cm}$?
questions.explanation:
The formula for the **surface area ($A$) of a sphere** with radius ($r$) is $A = 4pi r^2$.

Given radius $r = 25 	ext{ cm}$.
$$A = 4pi (25)^2$$
$$A = 4pi (625)$$
$$A = 2500pi 	ext{ cm}^2$$

This matches Option B.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements defines frustum of a pyramid?
options: It is a surface in space all points of which are equidistant from a point.
It is part of a pyramid included between the base of the pyramid and a horizontal cross-section made by the plane parallel to the base.
It is part of a cone included between the base of the cone and a plane parallel to the base.
It is part of a pyramid excluded the base of the pyramid and a horizontal cross-section made by the plane slant to the base.
questions.explanation: A **frustum** (of a pyramid or cone) is the portion that remains after cutting off the top part by a plane parallel to the base. Statement B is the correct definition for a frustum of a **pyramid** . Statement C defines a frustum of a **cone**. Statement A defines a sphere.
